title: F.INV.RT returns 0 at p = 1 when df2 >= 1 and inverts the published right-tail F surface directly on fallback
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, F.INV.RT(probability, deg_freedom1, deg_freedom2) shares FINV's right-tail quantile semantics: truncating degrees of freedom to integers >= 1, returning 0 at probability = 1 after degree validation (#NUM! at probability = 0 or degrees < 1), transforming the beta quantile via f_inverse_beta, and on fallback directly inverting the published right-tail F.DIST.RT surface rather than 1 - p on F.DIST to avoid small-p complement bias. Matches 4,322/4,434 full-bank rows, with 66 last-bit and 46 numeric discrepancies (worst 72 ULP) still open.
basis: Measured across 4,434 full-bank F.INV.RT rows in Excel 16.0.20527 (CalcFunc-Evidence {admit2,bank2}-answers-f.inv.rt-*.json) and prefix_metadata (row 79).
